chromium.evidence: Four scenarios passed on the final production build. In the original workbook the fixed corner remains at the same screen coordinates when both axes move, A1 can still be edited, and the first movable cell survives local ODS Save As, reload and XLSX download. Fixed column B and row 2 are hidden in the source, so the assertion finds the first movable cell by coordinate. An earlier concurrent run timed out on the neighboring active-sheet test. The browser config inherits production settings and uses an available preview port.

static.evidence: Scoped ESLint, Prettier and registry validation for all five altered runtime paths passed. Doctor retained its existing managed shim warning.

global_provenance_and_registry.evidence: The unchanged OfficeTooltips.tsx and available-menu-items.ts framework entries are still missing from the global registry. The invariants and parity scripts use the same registry checker.

browser_adaptation: A frozen band which cannot fit with the source's 30-pixel split margin is temporarily suppressed. The saved sheet layout remains available when the viewport grows or the file is exported. This preserves the imported file representation across browser resizes.
residual: Normal split windows still need independent visible grids, four movable scroll routes and corresponding focus behavior. The format already preserves their settings. The browser frozen grid shares a focus surface and does not update the native active-pane identity when navigating between fixed and movable portions.
Complete XLSX acceptance remains open. Full suites remain on the approved ten-task cadence.
